differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease (CKD-related)
differential.rationale: CKD with elevated creatinine and known diabetic kidney disease commonly causes EPO deficiency–mediated normocytic anemia.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Chronic oral infections (alveolitis, tooth infection, gingivitis) can cause occult blood loss; low MCV not provided but iron loss is a frequent cause of anemia in this setting.

differential.name: Vitamin B12 deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Black adults and those with dietary insufficiency may develop macrocytic anemia; B12 deficiency is a common reversible cause.

differential.name: Anemia secondary to chronic hypoxia from COPD
differential.rationale: Long‑standing COPD can lead to secondary polycythemia or, paradoxically, anemia of chronic disease due to hypoxic stress.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: At age 49 with unexplained anemia and multiple comorbidities, a primary marrow disorder is less likely but must be considered if work‑up is unrevealing.
